title: Lab 1: Personal Website
description: My first website, built from scratch with HTML. It has a home page, a photo, a navigation menu, and a contact form that opens my email app.

title: Lab 2: Styling with CSS
description: Added a stylesheet with a soft pink accent color, a flexbox navigation bar, a grid-based contact form, and a responsive projects layout.

title: Lab 3: Dark Mode and JavaScript
description: Made the navigation menu generate itself, highlighted the current page automatically, and added a theme switch that remembers your choice.

title: Lab 4: Projects from Data
description: Moved my project list into a JSON file and wrote a reusable function that draws the cards on both the home page and the projects page.

title: Dream Outfit Moodboard
description: A moodboard page for planning outfits, with color swatches, fabric notes, and a grid of favorite looks sorted by season.

title: Cozy Game Screenshot Gallery
description: A photo gallery of my favorite scenery and outfit screenshots from cozy video game worlds, laid out in a masonry-style grid.

title: Sweet Pea Bakery Chalkboard Menu
description: A hand-drawn menu design for a neighborhood bakery, later recreated as a printable web page with prices and seasonal specials.

title: Happy Paws Adoption Photos
description: Profile photos and short bios for shelter dogs, built to make the adoption website friendlier and easier to browse.

title: Tiny Sticker Shop
description: A small online shop for my hand-drawn sticker designs, including a product page, a price list, and a donation note for the shelter.

title: Campus Clothing Swap Poster
description: Event branding for a campus clothing swap: a poster, a sign-up page, and a simple map showing where to drop off donations.

title: Doodle Notebook Archive
description: Scanned pages from my doodle notebooks, sorted by theme, with short captions about what inspired each drawing.

title: Color Palette Generator
description: A tiny tool that picks matching pastel colors from a single starting hue, built while learning about color and contrast.
